title: Fiend battle-effect negation TagDuel adapter — Dark Ruler Ha Des + Dark Balter the Terrible

cards.name: Dark Ruler Ha Des
cards.officialText: Cannot be Special Summoned from the GY. Negate the effects of monsters destroyed by battle with Fiend monsters you control.

cards.name: Dark Balter the Terrible
cards.officialText: The effect of an Effect Monster that this monster destroys as a result of battle is negated.

testCoverage: Dark Ruler Ha Des suppresses an Effect Monster destroyed by battle with any Fiend controlled by its team
Ha Des does not apply to a non-Fiend attacker and requires a face-up, non-negated copy
Dark Balter suppresses an Effect Monster destroyed by battle with itself, not with another Fiend
Normal Monsters without a registered monster effect are not marked
The battle event must be a real opposing-team battle destruction
A negated Dark Balter attacker cannot apply its battle suppression
Dark Ruler Ha Des cannot be Special Summoned from the GY
Negation returns a UID marker for the shared effect pipeline without moving or granting cards
Fusion card remains in its physical Extra Deck inventory under the five-card cap
fixtureStrategy: Production defaults retain the official card IDs. Tests alias Ha Des to an enabled Fiend and Dark Balter to an enabled Fusion card; the destroyed target is an enabled Effect Monster with a registered monster-effect definition. Aliases are test-only and do not alter metadata, certificates, allowlist, catalog or inventory.
resolutionBoundary: The adapter returns the destroyed monster's physical UID and applicable negation source(s). The shared chain/GY-trigger pipeline must persist and enforce the negation marker; this isolated PR does not mutate the target or integrate that marker.
limitations: M61 still owns the protected resolver, metadata and certification files; this PR adds an isolated adapter only.
Dark Balter's Normal Spell negation by paying 1000 LP is not included in this battle-negation family.
The shared resolver must persist and enforce the returned negation UID; this adapter alone does not suppress downstream GY/Flip triggers.
The new card IDs are not yet playable/certified in engine-v9; tests use fixture aliases and do not count as engine-v9 certification.
No live Discord gateway/guild, production database, merge, deploy or backup restoration was exercised.
